review.reason: Adds a boolean flag `posthog_privacy_mode=True` to Google Generative AI client instantiation. While the comment claims this enables a privacy mode to keep customer content out of the internal project, the supplied hunk does not demonstrate the implementation, definition, or backend behavior of this mode. The tier is assigned conservatively as a narrow, localised maintenance change,
